verdict.rationale: Autumn has no automation or workflow product, but its `atmn` CLI defines plans and features as code in `autumn.config.ts`, which can be kept in git for versioning. You can review changes before applying them with `atmn preview` or `atmn push` (confirmed with `--yes`), and `atmn pull` syncs the dashboard state back into the local config. Rollback is only implied: you would re-push an older config yourself, and this covers pricing configuration rather than automations as such. Missing for 10: first-class versioning or history of automations, a documented rollback command, coverage of webhook- or schedule-driven automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
